Desktop app

Install UnifyHub on this computer. You get a full window, a tray icon, and Ctrl+/ quick search even when the browser is closed.

Windows installer

Windows installer.

  • Opens the same UnifyHub workspace you use in the browser.
  • Stays in the tray. Closing the window hides it instead of quitting.
  • Press Ctrl+/ from any app for quick search, notes, and tickets.

Windows says “protected your PC”

That is Microsoft SmartScreen. New apps without a paid code-signing certificate show this until Windows learns the publisher. UnifyHub is safe to install.

  1. Click More info.
  2. Click Run anyway.

After install, pin UnifyHub from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut.

Updates after you install

Chat, tickets, and the overlay UI update when this website is deployed — you do not need a new installer for those.

When we ship a new desktop shell, a new installer is published on this page. Installed apps check for updates on startup. Use Restart to apply update in the tray, or run the new installer over the old one.
